newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to sell April high sulphur fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to sell April high sulphur fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell at least one 30,000-tonne cargo of high sulphur fuel oil for April lifting, a company official said on Monday.

CPC is offering at least one cargo of 3.0-percent high sulphur fuel oil for delivery April 8-26 free-on-board (fob) from the southern port of Kaohsiung. "If the prices are good, we may sell not just one cargo at the tender," said the official.
The tender closes on March 13 and is valid for one day.
In its last tender, CPC sold three 30,000-tonne cargoes of 3.0-percent high sulphur fuel oil for March 12-28 delivery at $103 per tonne fob Kaohsiung.
